bio.text: Stephen Meeks is a Republican member of the Arkansas House of Representatives for District 42, which covers parts of Cleburne, Faulkner and Van Buren counties.
The legislature's member page lists Meeks's first House term as 2011, gives Meeks's occupation as computer technician, and shows Meeks as a veteran.

sources.title: Representative Stephen Meeks (R) - Arkansas State Legislature
